description:
[read-only] The connected account's trial: which one it is on (`current.label`, e.g. the 14-day posting trial, a plan trial or a comped plan), the day and days left, the end date, what it falls back to (`current.fallsBackTo`) and what happens at the end (`current.after`). `posts.heldCount` / `heldPosts`: booked posts held after a trial ended; they are never deleted and post again once the plan includes posting, with no re-booking. `terms` are the configured trial terms.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/account/trial.)
name: account_trial_get
title: Get the account trial
